format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/temperatures-catalunya.json]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/temperatures-catalunya.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json,re
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/temperatures-catalunya.json').read_text())
assert d['station_count']==182
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(9.4,9.3),layout='constrained')
g=d['boundary'];parts=g['coordinates'] if g['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [g['coordinates']]
extent=np.array(d['extent'])/1000;norm=Normalize(15,45);cmap=plt.colormaps['viridis'].copy();cmap.set_bad('white')
def map_panel(ax,title):
    for part in parts:ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(part[0])/1000,facecolor='none',edgecolor='#60707b',lw=.5))
    ax.set(xlim=extent[:2],ylim=extent[2:],aspect='equal',title=title,xticks=[],yticks=[])
    for spine in ax.spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
map_panel(axes[0,0],'A · 182 estacions XEMA')
xy=np.array([[p['x_m'],p['y_m']] for p in d['stations']])/1000
axes[0,0].scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],c=[p['tx_c'] for p in d['stations']],cmap=cmap,norm=norm,s=22,edgecolors='#38434b',linewidth=.3)
ax=axes[0,1];v=d['experimental_variogram']
x=np.array([r['distance_m'] for r in v])/1000;y=np.array([r['gamma_c2'] for r in v])
ax.scatter(x,y,s=45,color='#006699',label='Classes de parelles')
coeff={name:float(value) for name,value in re.findall(r'^([ab]) = ([-+\d.eE]+)',d['saga_log'],re.M)}
assert coeff.keys()=={'a','b'}
assert d['variogram_formula']=='a + b*x/100000'
h=np.linspace(.01,150,200);ax.plot(h,coeff['a']+coeff['b']*h/100,color='#b42b3b',lw=2,label='Model lineal SAGA')
ax.set(title='B · Semivariograma de les màximes',xlabel='Separació (km)',ylabel='Semivariància (°C²)',ylim=(0,None))
ax.legend(loc='upper left',frameon=False,fontsize=12.5)
for ax,name,title in [(axes[1,0],'idw','C · IDW, exponent 2'),(axes[1,1],'kriging','D · Kriging ordinari')]:
    a=np.array(d['fields'][name]);image=ax.imshow(np.ma.masked_equal(a,-9999),extent=extent,origin='upper',cmap=cmap,norm=norm)
    map_panel(ax,title)
bar=fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm,cmap=cmap),ax=[axes[0,0],axes[1,0],axes[1,1]],orientation='horizontal',fraction=.025,pad=.02,shrink=.9)
bar.set_label('Temperatura màxima del 15-08-2025, dia TU (°C) · mateixa escala de color')
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/temperatures-catalunya.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
